full_judgment:
Mahmudul Amin Chowdhury J: This appeal is directed against the judgment and decree passed by the learned Subordinate Judge, Chandpur in Title suit No. 87 of 1987. The trial Court by judgment dated 21-9-1992 rejected the plaint under Order 7, rule 11(d) of the Code of Civil Procedure. 

 11. The judgment and decree passed by the learned Subordinate Judge in the aforesaid suit is hereby set aside and the learned Subordinate Judge is hereby directed to proceed with the suit in accordance with law.
